title: Identifier-Free Code Embedding Models for Scalable Search
abstract: arXiv:2605.05251v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Function association is a useful process for binary reverse engineers. Search tools exist to perform association at scale, but they do not utilize the full range of capabilities that AI-enabled search provides. Prior work has explored the development of embedding models for association between certain reverse engineering code representations, but that work does not cover bidirectional association between source code and decompiled, stripped code with standard preprocessing requirements. To bridge this gap, we formalize this function association problem and evaluate the extent to which embedding models can bidirectionally associate between these two representations. To improve model performance at this task, we fine-tune a Qwen3-Embedding model with contrastive learning. translated_title: 面向可扩展搜索的无标识符代码嵌入模型
translated_abstract: 函数关联对二进制逆向工程师来说是一项非常有用的技术。目前已有可在大规模场景下执行关联的搜索工具，但它们并未充分利用AI赋能搜索所提供的全部能力。先前的工作已探索了为某些逆向工程代码表示之间的关联开发嵌入模型，但这些工作并未涵盖在标准预处理要求下源代码与去除符号的反编译代码之间的双向关联。为了填补这一空白，我们对这一函数关联问题进行了形式化定义，并评估了嵌入模型在这两种代码表示之间实现双向关联的能力。为提升模型在该任务上的性能，我们使用对比学习对Qwen3-Embedding模型进行了微调。我们发现，我们的新模型在所有函数关联基线测试中均以显著优势超越其他模型，并能泛化至常数算法关联等场景（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文形式化了源代码与去除符号的反编译代码之间的双向函数关联问题，并通过对比学习微调Qwen3-Embedding模型，在所有基线测试中大幅超越现有模型。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes bidirectional function association between source code and stripped decompiled code, and fine-tunes a Qwen3-Embedding model with contrastive learning, substantially outperforming all existing baselines.
